incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging alert for Aventis (enterprise-dedicated-eu-1): elevated 5xx rate on /api/generate since 02:04 UTC, p95 latency 1.2s, error rate 6.8% > paging threshold. Triggering page to oncall rotation. Link: https://redwood.inc/alerts/6278901234
maria: I'm on it, grabbing oncall from rotation, @sanjay please monitor logs and traces
sanjay: joining, tailing logs now. seeing repeated model timeouts 504 from triton pool 3
jess (oncall): took page, moving to prod pod eu-3, running `kubectl get pods -l svc=generator -n prod-eu`
opsbot: Deploy bot: Snapshot created for prod-eu at commit abc123
maria: quick customer-impact check — Aventis uses Dedicated pool eu-1. Are they seeing failed inference requests or only latency?
jess (oncall): confirmed 5xx returning to customer integrations. Sample logs show `grpc: deadline exceeded` from inference-proxy -> runtime
sanjay: looks like model variant fallback kicked in, KV cache pressure spiked. Raising capacity on pool: `infra scale --pool eu-triton-3 --replicas +2`
maria: draft status page: "We are investigating elevated error rates impacting model inference for select enterprise customers in EU. Engineers are mitigating and we will update in 15 minutes." Thoughts?
ryan (acct-ops): please add tailored blurb for Aventis: "Aventis — you may experience failed generation calls and delays for the next ~30m. We're prioritizing your dedicated pool and will follow up with an ETA." Keep it short
jess (oncall): scaled pool, restarting proxy on eu-3. I'll post logs after restart. Running `kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-proxy -n prod-eu`
maria: notification checklist for Aventis: 1) primary tech contact: @paul. 2) CSM: @elaine. 3) Legal/Sales on standby. Will send targeted note and status page update after next check
paul (Aventis): receiving errors now, thanks for the ping. Please prioritize — experiment runs blocked
maria: sending tailored customer message now (DM): "Hi Paul — we're aware of failed inference calls affecting your cluster in EU. Engineers are scaling dedicated pool and expect stabilization within 30 minutes. We'll follow up with exact recovery time and root cause once we verify. —Maria, Redwood Ops". Sending now :email:
jess (oncall): proxy restarted, initial healthchecks passing, 5xx down to 1.1%, p95 latency 480ms. Continuing to monitor
sanjay: taking deltas on KV cache sizing for postmortem. saving traces to S3: s3://redwood-ops/incidents/6278901234/traces
maria: updating status page and pinging account ops. Next update in 15
opsbot: Incident incident-6278901234 created, severity: high, responders: jess,sanjay,maria. Playbook: dedicated-pool-failures
ryan (acct-ops): Sent tailored update to Aventis leadership and flagged for 1:1 follow up
maria: closing loop: escalation to infra if we see >2% for 10m. For now mark as 'mitigating'. Will draft postmortem template after stability
paul (Aventis): thanks team, things look better. I'll loop in my infra. Keep me posted
jess (oncall): marking thread resolved in 30m if metrics stay stable. Will create follow-up ticket for root cause analysis
maria: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
